newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia mulls building hydro-electric power station.
newsitem.headline: Zambia mulls building hydro-electric power station.

text.p: Zambia is considering constructing a 500 megawatt hydro-electric power station in the lower basin of the Kafue river to supplement existing power stations, the country's energy minister said on Thursday.
Mann Muyuni told Reuters the planned power station would generate more power than the country needs.
"The station will produce power far in excess of our energy requirements. The country will start exporting substantially to neighbouring states," he added.
A feasibility study was currently being undertaken on the project, Muyuni said.
Zambia's state-owned Zambia Electricity Supply Corp (ZESCO) currently operates three power stations with a capacity of 1,608 megawatts.
